lead.headline: St. Thomas wins by 28 at Milwaukee and moves to first
lead.deck: The Tommies won 98-70 as 1.5-point favorites and took over the power rankings. South Dakota State lost twice as a favorite.
body: St. Thomas went to Milwaukee as a 1.5-point favorite and won 98-70. Jeremy Lorenz had 25 points and 10 rebounds, and Hayden Tibbits added 22 and five assists. That moved the Tommies from second to first in the power rankings. They lost 86-77 at UNC Wilmington as 5.5-point underdogs later in the week, but our model has them 104th nationally at plus-6.8 points per 100 possessions, the best rating in the league by more than nine points.

South Dakota State had the week nobody wanted. The Jackrabbits were 5.5-point favorites at Idaho State and lost 86-71 while Malachi Johnson put up 39 and 13. Back home, they were 7-point favorites against Abilene Christian and lost 101-95. Joe Sayler scored 25 and 27, and it didn't matter. They still have the league's best record at 5-2.

Oral Roberts went 2-0. Luke Gray scored 32 in a 78-74 win over Texas A&M-Corpus Christi, then the Golden Eagles won 84-80 at UT Arlington as 5-point underdogs, with Cal Furnish scoring 21 and Boden Williams 20. Gray picked up his third Summit League weekly honor, per thesummitleague.org.

North Dakota won 77-67 at Detroit Mercy as a 4.5-point favorite, then lost 73-72 at home to SE Louisiana. South Dakota won 74-73 at Utah Tech, a push as a 1-point favorite, and beat Arkansas-Pine Bluff 86-50.
The league went 7-8 this week. Omaha and Kansas City went a combined 0-4.

column.label: Look Ahead
column.title: A busy holiday weekend, starting today
body: **Liberty at St. Thomas, Friday, noon.** The Tommies are 1-point favorites and our model makes it 3.2, total 146.5. The new No. 1 in the power rankings gets a home game against a real opponent. We lean Tommies.
**Missouri State at Oral Roberts, Friday, 8 p.m.** Golden Eagles by 3.5, total 142.5. Luke Gray at home after a 32-point week.
**Montana State at South Dakota, Monday, 8 p.m.** The Big Sky's best team by our numbers visits the Coyotes. No line posted yet.

notes.headline: Omaha's rough stretch
notes.body: The Mavericks lost 80-78 at UC Davis and 71-62 at home to Pacific. Grant Stubblefield had 22 at Davis. Jacksonville State visits tonight with Omaha a 6-point underdog.

notes.headline: Kansas City two close losses
notes.body: The Roos lost 62-61 at Iona as 4.5-point underdogs, then 77-72 at home to Green Bay as 1-point favorites. Lincoln Goodwin had 19 at Iona.

notes.headline: North Dakota State rolled
notes.body: The Bison beat Wisconsin-Stout 84-49 behind Riley Massey's 23. They play at North Texas tonight, then host Drake on Saturday.

notes.headline: Circle it: Liberty at St. Thomas
notes.body: Friday, 12 p.m. ET. Tommies by 1, our model by 3.2, total 146.5.
